name: Unidentified HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class freighter
description: An HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 was owned by a Quarren male on Coruscant during the Clone Wars until it was stolen by Moralo Eval, Cad Bane and Rako Hardeen when they escaped from the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center.
